purpose: sequence-count/head boundary experiment; no dispatcher mutation

policy_definition.hypothesis: M=N_seq*H alone may predict the v2/v4/baseline winner.
policy_definition.predeclared_stop_rule: For any measured FLA-public state contract, reject an M-only dispatch policy if any fixed, balanced-varlen, or skewed-varlen representation at the same M has a different winner at P50/P95/P99.  Raw latency equality is not required; the identity of the winner at each percentile is the comparison.
policy_definition.promotion_rule: M-only policy is eligible for a separate dispatcher decision only if every tested M has at least two distinct (N_seq,H) factorizations, every case has one winner across P50/P95/P99 with at least a 2% runner-up margin, and every same-M form/factorization selects that same winner for all measured contracts. Eligibility does not override unmeasured shapes or existing fail-closed guards.

fixed_tp8_batch_focus.reason: separate exact-shape gate before considering a fixed B=2/3/4,H=12,T=2048 FLA whitelist
